relationships.subject: Erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Monoclonal antibodies inhibiting CGRP are effective in reducing monthly headache days in migraine patients with MOH.

key_findings: In 303 chronic migraine patients with MOH, 80% had at least 50% reduction in headache days and analgesic intake at 3 months, 78.8% at 6 months, without withdrawal.
